summary: A Depth subscription on NIFTY: the 32-byte full index packet adds the exchange time, which becomes ltt; an index has no book, so the frame has none.

deviations.reason: Kite's index packet carries the change but not the percent; the web sends 0 (zerodha_adapter.py:626, tick.get('price_change_percent', 0)), the desktop works it out from the change and the previous close (200.10 / 24300 = 0.82%).
The web sends the exchange time in epoch seconds as ltt (zerodha_adapter.py:620); feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md), as the desktop sends it.
